facts.text: We packed four bucks of food for a two day walk. Teddy's already eaten half of it.
facts.why: Set out as the character's own words, but the film does not have them say it. The nearest real moment is the boys finding they have no food and counting their money; Teddy says 'Oh, well, this is great! What are we supposed to do, eat our feet?'.
facts.fix: Oh, well, this is great! What are we supposed to do, eat our feet?
